headline: Pennsylvania 2026 just initialized. Nothing is built.

stages.title: Roster reconciled to the official listing (or the best labeled source)
TIP gap list shown to the owner; approved fixes applied
State pages built locally (hub, governor, Senate, House directory, districts)
Candidate registry built and validated (data/candidates/PA.json); gaps.csv reviewed
Story Scout: ranked angles with READY or NOT_READY
Image briefs (state tile and story heroes)
State tile image returned and installed
Deploy state pages, articles and tile
Video asset pack (after approved articles and script direction)
stages.note: asset pack only; no MP4 unless explicitly requested

articles.chat: unrecorded (owner: record the title in docs/production/CHAT_REGISTRY.md)
articles.role: Write the article drafts from Claude's briefs. Never fact-check your own draft. Never publish.

images.chat: unrecorded (owner: record the title in docs/production/CHAT_REGISTRY.md)
images.role: Make illustrated images from the briefs. Match the existing set. Never make faces, readable text or campaign branding.

claude_tasks.title: Build the roster and reconcile it to the official listing
TIP export, join and gap list
claude_tasks.gate: owner approval before any TIP write

claude_tasks.title: Portraits, markets, state pages, tests, strict build
python tools/elections/build_registry.py PA (then build.py --strict); turn productions/2026/PA/gaps.csv into the TIP fix list
claude_tasks.gate: owner approval before any TIP write

claude_tasks.title: Story Scout, then briefs and claims for every READY angle; add them as tasks in the articles lane
Image briefs; add them as tasks in the images lane

conflicts_to_watch: Only one Claude session writes to this state at a time

readback_checks.q: May you fact-check your own draft, and who does?
May you cite a TIP grade that is not visible on the linked profile?
What does a Kalshi price represent?
What are the three things the image must never contain?
What credit line will the page print under the image?
